coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mission Bay Ferry Landing
record.distance_note: Sited near Agua Vista Park on Terry A. Francois Blvd, within the stretch DataSF's official 'Former San Francisco Redevelopment Agency Project Areas' boundary marks as Mission Bay South, and about 270m from Mission Bay South's own nearest tracked feature -- versus roughly 1,000m from Mission Rock's tracked footprint. No primary source found places this project at "former Pier 64"; that description, from an owner-supplied unsourced summary, is not repeated in this record. Recorded as adjacent to Mission Bay rather than tracked because it is a Port/WETA transit facility, not a Mission Bay OCII development block.

record.summary: A WETA/Port of San Francisco ferry terminal under construction on Terry A. Francois Blvd near Agua Vista Park, in the Mission Bay/Central Waterfront area. Marine demolition of derelict piles was reported complete in 2025; ferry-landing and upland construction is under way, targeted for completion by the end of 2027.

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- a coarse placeholder box, not a traced footprint, for the same reasons as data/manual/pier70_dry_docks.geojson (no parcel, no source figure). Primary sources describe the site only as 'adjacent to the intersection of Terry A. Francois Boulevard and 16th Street... adjacent to Agua Vista Park' -- no source found calls this site 'former Pier 64' (a distinct, still-separate 'Pier 64 Sediment Cleanup' line item appears in the Port's own draft Five-Year CIP), so this box is NOT placed at Pier 64 and that claim is not repeated in this record. The box does not represent the real ferry landing's true shape (a floating dock projecting into the Bay plus upland improvements) or its full extent.
notes.digitized_from: No Assessor block/lot exists for this Port/WETA ferry facility (confirmed: DataSF's 'Parcels - Active and Retired' Socrata dataset, acdm-wktn, has no PIER-numbered street_name entries near this site). No Port/WETA/SFCTA GIS shapefile or site-plan figure was available, so this is a coarse locational box centered near Agua Vista Park (801 Terry A. Francois Blvd, a real, addressed park immediately next to the project per the Port's own project page), using the real DataSF street-centerline address range for that stretch of Terry A. Francois Blvd (data/raw/official_street_centerlines.geojson).
notes.why_no_real_parcel: Port/WETA ferry facility; not on the Assessor's secured roll (data.sf.gov acdm-wktn has no PIER-numbered parcels near this site).
notes.regulatory_context: A WETA/Port of San Francisco ferry terminal project. Marine demolition of derelict piles (Phase 2a) was reported complete in 2025; ferry-landing and upland construction (Phase 2b) is under way, with completion targeted by the end of 2027. The San Francisco County Transportation Authority approved sales-tax (Prop L) funding toward the project, including a further allocation reported in April 2026.

open_questions: No primary source found describing this project's site as "former Pier 64"; the Port's own draft Five-Year CIP separately lists a distinct "Pier 64 Sediment Cleanup" line item, suggesting "Pier 64" remains a separate Port designation from this ferry landing.

The project's total budget is reported inconsistently across secondary sources (some cite a much larger total project cost); only the SFCTA-confirmed $9.8M Prop L sales-tax allocation (April 2026) is recorded here as a directly sourced cost figure.
Exact construction start and phase-by-phase dates for Phase 2b (ferry landing plus upland improvements) beyond the year-end-2027 completion target are not established here.

record.notes: This is a Port/WETA transit facility, not an OCII Mission Bay South development block -- grouped under the Mission Bay South site here because that is the nearest tracked site and because DataSF's official 'Former San Francisco Redevelopment Agency Project Areas' boundary (data/raw/redevelopment_project_areas.geojson) for Mission Bay South extends north along the Terry A. Francois Blvd shoreline to include this stretch (contains this location; see the PR body's geometry test). Recorded as adjacent rather than tracked because it is Port/WETA transit infrastructure, not a Mission Bay OCII development parcel like this site's other tracked records.
